details: picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

cna.title: Modcluster-core: mod_cluster advertise listener: unauthenticated dos via crafted multicast datagram

descriptions.value: A flaw was found in mod_cluster's AdvertiseListenerImpl (org.jboss.modcluster core module). A single crafted UDP multicast datagram with a valid HTTP status line and a "Server:" header but without the "Date:", "Digest:", and "Sequence:" headers triggers a NullPointerException in verifyDigest() that is not caught by the worker thread's exception handler. This causes the advertise listener thread to terminate permanently. The failure is silent (isListening() continues to return true) and persists until the node is restarted. The crash occurs before the AdvertiseSecurityKey comparison, so deployments with a configured security key are still affected.

workarounds.value: Disable multicast-based proxy advertisement and use static proxy configuration instead. When advertisement must be enabled, ensure the multicast network segment (default 224.0.1.105:23364) is properly isolated and not accessible from untrusted network segments.

credits.value: Red Hat would like to thank Kien Pham (Ninh Thanh Cyber Security (NTCS)) and Ta Duc Thien (Ninh Thanh Cyber Security (NTCS)) for reporting this issue.

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Stack Buffer Underwrite via Telnet Dissector Backspace Handling

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains a stack buffer underwrite vulnerability in the telnet dissector in src/dissectors/ec_telnet.c that decrements the output pointer on backspace without a lower bound check. Attackers can send a telnet stream with more backspaces than preceding characters to write below the stack buffer, corrupting the stack of the Ettercap process that normally runs as root.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Stack Buffer Underwrite via Telnet Dissector Backspace Handling

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via HTTP NTLM Authentication Parsing

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Parse_NTLM_Auth() in src/dissectors/ec_http.c due to unvalidated NTLM message offsets. Attackers can send a crafted HTTP Authorization header observed by Ettercap to read beyond the buffer, disclosing memory or crashing the process.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via HTTP NTLM Authentication Parsing

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Stack Buffer Overflow via WPA CCMP Decryption

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains an integer underflow in ccmp_decrypt() in src/ec_encryption_ccmp.c that subtracts the 8-byte CCMP trailer without checking minimum length. Attackers on a network whose WPA key is loaded can send a short crafted CCMP frame to overflow a stack buffer in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Stack Buffer Overflow via WPA CCMP Decryption

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via sslw_remove_sts

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains an out-of-bounds read and size_t underflow vulnerability in sslw_remove_sts() in src/ec_sslwrap.c, caused by a stale length and an unchecked memmem() result when stripping Strict-Transport-Security headers. A malicious HTTPS server whose response passes through Ettercap's SSL interception can trigger out-of-bounds reads and memory corruption in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Out-of-Bounds Read via sslw_remove_sts

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via TLS SNI Parsing

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in sslw_get_clienthello_sni() in src/ec_sslwrap.c that trusts the unchecked 16-bit SNI length field. Network-adjacent attackers can send crafted TLS ClientHello messages during SSL interception to leak up to 64 KB of heap memory upstream or crash Ettercap.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via TLS SNI Parsing

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Heap Buffer Overflow via Gadu-Gadu Dissector

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in gg_get_version() in src/dissectors/ec_gg.c that writes up to 44 bytes into a 30-byte allocation. Remote attackers can send Gadu-Gadu traffic on TCP port 8074 with a crafted version field through a monitored network to corrupt heap memory in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Heap Buffer Overflow via Gadu-Gadu Dissector

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Use-After-Free via PCRE2 Filter Substitution

descriptions.value: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in func_pcre() in src/ec_filter.c that reads the PCRE2 ovector after freeing match data. Network-adjacent attackers can send packets matching a loaded pcre_regex() substitution filter to corrupt memory and potentially execute code as root.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 Use-After-Free via PCRE2 Filter Substitution

credits.value: Adiel Sol, Arad Inbar, Erez Cohen, Nir Somech, Ben Grinberg, Daniel Lubel, Shir Sadon (DREAM Security Research Team)

cna.title: Fluxion before 6.39 OS Command Injection via Crafted SSID

descriptions.value: Fluxion before 6.39 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the fluxion.sh target scanner, which decodes access point ESSIDs with eval after escaping only single quotes. Attackers within Wi-Fi range can broadcast an access point with a crafted SSID to execute commands as root when the operator scans or selects it.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Fluxion before 6.39 OS Command Injection via Crafted SSID

cna.title: Instatic before 0.0.21 Authorization Bypass via Row Author Reassignment Endpoint

descriptions.value: Instatic before 0.0.21 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in handleRowAuthor that allows authenticated users to skip table-level access checks by loading rows with getDataRow() instead of loadRowForAccess(). Attackers holding content.edit.any but lacking data.system.tables.read can send PATCH requests to /admin/api/cms/data/rows/:id/author to read system-table rows and reassign their authors.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Instatic before 0.0.21 Authorization Bypass via Row Author Reassignment Endpoint

cna.title: NocoBase plugin-ai 2.1.0 through 2.2.41 Authorization Bypass via Sub-Agent Username Override

descriptions.value: NocoBase plugin-ai 2.1.0 through 2.2.41 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getAccessibleAIEmployee() that lets authenticated users access unassigned AI employees by overriding the role-derived filter with a supplied username. Attackers can use the dispatch-sub-agent-task tool to run ungranted AI employees with their tools and permissions, and get-ai-employee to read their prompts and tool configuration.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: NocoBase plugin-ai 2.1.0 through 2.2.41 Authorization Bypass via Sub-Agent Username Override

cna.title: Ghostscript before 10.08.0 -dSAFER Bypass via .putgstringcopy .forceput Recovery

descriptions.value: Ghostscript before 10.08.0 contains a -dSAFER bypass vulnerability in the .putgstringcopy procedure in gs_fonts.ps, which calls the privileged .forceput operator without checking operand types. Attackers can supply crafted PostScript or PDF documents that trigger a type error, recover .forceput via a custom error handler, and cause a use-after-free across save/restore to execute arbitrary code.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ghostscript before 10.08.0 -dSAFER Bypass via .putgstringcopy .forceput Recovery

cna.title: Ampache before 8.4.0 Stored XSS via Song Lyrics ID3 Tag

descriptions.value: Ampache before 8.4.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows users with upload rights to inject script through unescaped song lyrics in LyricsView.php getLyrics() and show_lyrics.inc.php. Attackers can upload a song whose lyrics ID3 tag contains HTML and script to execute code in the browser of any user viewing the lyrics.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Ampache before 8.4.0 Stored XSS via Song Lyrics ID3 Tag

cna.title: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 Use-After-Free via Stale Brush Cache Pointer

descriptions.value: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in update_gdi_patblt(), update_gdi_polygon_cb() and update_gdi_mem3blt() that retain stale brush cache pointers. A malicious RDP server can resend CACHE_BRUSH to the same slot then send PATBLT, causing clients to read freed heap memory, disclosing data or crashing.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 Use-After-Free via Stale Brush Cache Pointer

cna.title: MailEnable Enterprise Premium before 10.62 Heap Overflow via IMAP X-FB-FETCH

descriptions.value: MailEnable Enterprise Premium before 10.62 contains a heap overflow vulnerability in the IMAP X-FB-FETCH command that allows authenticated users to overflow a fixed 0x400-byte heap buffer. Attackers can supply an X-FB-USER address longer than about 1016 bytes, which is formatted without a length check, to crash the IMAP service and cause denial of service.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: MailEnable Enterprise Premium before 10.62 Heap Overflow via IMAP X-FB-FETCH

cna.title: Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via BIND8 edit_recs.cgi ALL View

descriptions.value: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in bind8/edit_recs.cgi that outputs raw DNS record values without HTML escaping in ALL view mode. Delegated zone users such as Virtualmin domain owners can store record values containing script that executes in an administrator's browser when viewing zone records.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via BIND8 edit_recs.cgi ALL View

cna.title: Webmin through 2.670 OS Command Injection via Samba User Account Options

descriptions.value: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in samba/save_euser.cgi that allows authenticated Samba user maintainers to inject commands via unvalidated opts parameter. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters in account option flags passed by create_user and modify_user to backquote_logged, executing commands as root.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Webmin through 2.670 OS Command Injection via Samba User Account Options

cna.title: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Local File Read via processUploadQueue

descriptions.value: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 contains an arbitrary local file read vulnerability in FolderController::actionProcessUploadQueue that allows authenticated users to read server files by supplying absolute paths in the blobs parameter. Attackers can have files hard-linked or copied into their own folder and downloaded, exposing other users' stored files and config.php database credentials.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Local File Read via processUploadQueue

cna.title: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Stored XSS via filterXSS Bypass

descriptions.value: Intermesh Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the email viewer due to a flawed regex in StringHelper::filterXSS. Remote attackers can send emails containing tags like svg/onload, which MessagePanel.js renders raw, executing script in the recipient's session when opened.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Stored XSS via filterXSS Bypass

cna.title: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Missing Authorization in Forms Report Download

descriptions.value: Intermesh Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to download form reports via api/download.php without permission checks. Attackers can request the business/forms/report blob with a form ID to export every submission as an XLSX file, disclosing submissions they are not permitted to see.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Group-Office before 6.8.181, 25.0.116, and 26.0.58 Missing Authorization in Forms Report Download

cna.title: Faveo Helpdesk through 2.0.3 Cross-Department Ticket Tampering via TicketController

descriptions.value: Faveo Helpdesk through 2.0.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in TicketController that allows authenticated agents to modify tickets outside their department by referencing raw ticket IDs. Attackers can call merge-tickets, change-owner, ticket/assign and ticket/surrender endpoints to close, merge or reassign other departments' tickets and enumerate customers' ticket subjects.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Faveo Helpdesk through 2.0.3 Cross-Department Ticket Tampering via TicketController

cna.title: langchain4j-aideepin through 3.32.0 IDOR via /character/message reference endpoints

descriptions.value: langchain4j-aideepin through 3.32.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in CharacterMessageController that allows authenticated users to access other users' message references due to missing owner checks. Attackers can supply another user's message uuid to the knowledge-embedding-ref, memory-embedding-ref, or graph-ref endpoints to retrieve knowledge-base chunks, long-term memory text, and knowledge-graph data.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: langchain4j-aideepin through 3.32.0 IDOR via /character/message reference endpoints

cna.title: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Path Traversal via FileDocument/GetDocument and FileImage/GetImage

descriptions.value: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary files via the documentName and imageName parameters. Attackers can self-register and supply traversal sequences to GetDocument or GetImage, which use Path.Combine without containment checks, to read files like appsettings.json.

descriptions.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Path Traversal via FileDocument/GetDocument and FileImage/GetImage

cna.title: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Default Administrator Credentials via UserAdminSeeder

descriptions.value: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 contains a default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access because UserAdminSeeder creates admin@root.com with password 123456. Attackers can log in with these credentials, which carry every admin role and no forced password change, to fully control deployments that kept them.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Default Administrator Credentials via UserAdminSeeder

cna.title: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Hard-Coded JWT Signing Key Authentication Bypass

descriptions.value: INDOTALENT WHMS (Asp.Net-Core-Inventory-Order-Management-System) before 10.20261109 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability caused by a hard-coded JWT signing key, issuer and audience in appsettings.json. Unauthenticated remote attackers can forge tokens for any user ID and role that the Tokens/DI.cs validator trusts, gaining administrator access to the entire API.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: INDOTALENT WHMS before 10.20261109 Hard-Coded JWT Signing Key Authentication Bypass

cna.title: Map-OS 5.0.0 to before 5.2.2 Privilege Escalation via /api/v1/usuarios

descriptions.value: Map-OS 5.0.0 to before 5.2.2 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the REST users API that allows non-administrator operators holding the cUsuario permission to bypass permission-delegation and super-administrator protections. Attackers can send POST, PUT, or DELETE requests to /api/v1/usuarios to assign the Administrador group, reset the super administrator password, or delete higher-privileged users.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: Map-OS 5.0.0 to before 5.2.2 Privilege Escalation via /api/v1/usuarios

cna.title: DataRoom through 3.0.0 SQL Injection via MyBatisService.generateSql

descriptions.value: DataRoom through 3.0.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in MyBatisService.generateSql that allows sharer-role users to inject SQL by supplying crafted dataset parameters. Attackers can send crafted inputParam values to /dataRoom/dataset/run, exploiting unquoted string parameters or MySQL backslash escapes, to execute injected SQL against the database.

descriptions.description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: DataRoom through 3.0.0 SQL Injection via MyBatisService.generateSql

cna.title: DataRoom through 3.0.0 Incorrect Authorization via /dataRoom/dataset/run/test

descriptions.value: DataRoom through 3.0.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in DatasetController.runTest that allows visitor-role users to execute dataset definitions supplied in the request body. Attackers can specify an arbitrary dataSourceCode and raw SELECT SQL to query any configured relational data source using its stored decrypted credentials, bypassing developer-only restrictions.

references.name: VulnCheck Advisory: DataRoom through 3.0.0 Incorrect Authorization via /dataRoom/dataset/run/test
